context: Reported affected behavior and version metadata
public_summary: Issue #6914 reports that in Rock 19.1.8 non-admin users with Edit on a content channel and the block could not manage items unless they also had Edit on the Content Channel Item entity. The issue is closed and labeled Fixed in v19.3.

Rock 19.3 release notes state that the Content Channel Item List block now shows add and delete options based on Edit access to the selected content channel instead of Edit on the Content Channel Item entity, fixing issue #6914.

At commit 4d2eb5b7b236e5e76023c6a9c46685175b6c1811, ContentChannelItemList.GetIsAddDeleteEnabled obtains the configured ContentChannel and checks Authorization.EDIT against that channel. The source comment explains that checking a new ContentChannelItem fell back to entity-type security and ignored channel-specific Edit access.
